note: AI.md job 6: 'the validator ships with a corpus of at least 30 deliberately bad outputs, one per failure mode: invented numbers, invented months, a fabricated quote, a causal claim, a condition name, an added question.' Each case is one paragraph the model could plausibly write against the brief below, and the fault the validator must catch. Every one of these is a sentence a language model writes readily, which is the point.
